card.name: Effect words before 'of' another drug
card.fires_on: Words like effect, action, activity, caused or produced that come right before 'of' or 'by' and a second, different drug or agent. Found in drug-interaction sections.

modes.label: Effect of another drug
modes.description: A noun such as effect, action or activity after a drug-effect adjective, about to name the other drug.
modes.example: Aspirin inhibits the uricosuric<< effects>> of uricosuric agents.

modes.label: Caused by another substance
modes.description: Participles caused or produced, followed by 'by' and the other substance.
modes.example: does not increase the impairment of mental and motor skills<< caused>> by ethanol.

modes.label: Prevent others from
modes.description: The word 'from' after the opposing team, in a general sports passage.
modes.example: actively try to prevent the opposing team<< from>> making points or baskets.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning 'someone else's' or 'other', so the next words refer to another party.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to name a second drug or party whose effect is being changed.
